messages:
camila: dropping a quick UX check 10 for the SLO alert editor — added a compact "Notify multiplier" control and a live 'Who gets notified' preview. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/notify-preview-compact
sean: nice! one thing: when multiplier >1, preview should show which channels will escalate vs delay. suggest small badges 'escalates' and 'delayed'.
jess: copy nit: label 'Notify multiplier' felt terse to a PM I showed. maybe 'Notify multiplier (SLO burn)' or add an inline help link.
camila: leaning 'Notify multiplier (SLO burn)' + tooltip. tooltip copy proposal: "How quickly we consume SLO budget compared to default. 1x = default." thoughts?
ron: accessibility: slider must support arrow keys in 0.1 steps, page up/down 0.5, and home/end to min/max. add aria-live="polite" on the preview summary but avoid repeating a long list on every small change.
aria-bot: accessibility note: ensure slider has role="slider", aria-valuemin="0.1", aria-valuemax="5.0", and aria-valuenow updated. preview summary should be concise e.g. 'Will notify: PagerDuty(2), Slack(1), Email(1)'.
jess: suppressed channels: should we surface them? i think yes, show with '(suppressed)' and a muted icon; make them focusable and allow jump-to-quiet-window from preview.
sean: visual treatment: suppressed items at 60% opacity, with a subtle gray pill 'suppressed'. add hover tooltip 'suppressed by quiet window'.
ron: keyboard path: tooltip must appear on focus as well as hover. tooltips should use role="tooltip" and be referenced by aria-describedby for the element.
camila: performance: throttle preview updates while dragging to 120ms and show a tiny skeleton if computation takes >200ms. prevents jank during drag.
aria-bot: contrast check: orange (#FF8C42) used for 'escalates' fails AA for 12px regular. recommend #E65A00 or bold label + small outline for small text. ensure focus ring is >=3px in dark themes.
sean: microcopy under slider: '1x = default. Higher values notify earlier.' short and clear.
jess: preview readout should favor structured labels for screenreaders, e.g. 'Will notify: PagerDuty, two recipients; Slack, one channel' rather than 'Pages: 3 channels'.
camila: plan: update figma with label change, tooltip copy, keyboard increments, aria attributes, legend (escalates/notify/suppressed), throttled preview and focusable suppressed items. will post updated frames later today.
ron: i'll add QA tickets for: slider aria updates, keyboard increments, and suppressed-state visual regression.
aria-bot: reminder: include keyboard-only walkthrough and aria expectations in the PR description.
camila: thanks all! ping me if you want to pair on the microcopy. :sparkles:
